create_cube_trajectory_env: create a CubeTrajectoryEnv with a RandomInitializer and POSITION action type for simulation
run_cube_trajectory_step: run a single step of the CubeTrajectoryEnv with a joint position action
reset_cube_trajectory_env: reset the CubeTrajectoryEnv to initialize a new episode with a fresh trajectory
compute_reward_cube_trajectory: compute the reward for an achieved goal position against the desired goal trajectory
create_fixed_initializer: create a FixedInitializer with a validated trajectory for deterministic cube movement episodes
